children: Uber Technologies completed a public offering of notes totalling 4.5 billion euros, which is equal to about $5.19 billion.
The senior notes are due between 2029 and 2046, with rates ranging from 3.75% to 5.25%.
The notes are senior unsecured debt obligations for Uber. They were issued pursuant to an original debt dated Sept. 9, 2024.
Uber plans to use proceeds for general corporate purposes, it said.
